svg.title: Rat · Gray
svg.desc: Large gray laboratory rat with dilute silver-gray fur, robust upright trunk, broad muzzle, large hind feet, and substantial tail. Biological basis: Dilute pigmentation softens dark coat tones while preserving the anatomical proportions of the laboratory rat.
